item.title: Summit sees Galway reaffirm its edge in Ireland’s digital creative economy
item.description: Ireland’s first ever Creative Economy Summit will take place in Galway this summer – at the newly-renovated home of Connacht Rugby. item.title: House building figures rise but more still to do
item.description: There were 1,478 new homes completed in Galway in 2025 – an increase of 235 homes on the previous year or a growth of almost 16 per cent.
